title: Interaction Designer
profile: Interaction and UX/UI Designer with 2 years of industry experience designing web and mobile products, supported by an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University applying service design and human-centred design to real-world briefs. Experienced across the end-to-end design process, from user research and synthesis of research findings through user flows, information architecture, wireframes and interactive prototypes to high-fidelity UI design in Figma. Strong at explaining design decisions with user insights and working with developers and stakeholders in multidisciplinary teams to turn complex user and business needs into clear, accessible experiences.
